info.title: Mavio API
info.description:
Mavio's API is a set of [Connect](https://connectrpc.com) services: each
method is a `POST` to `/<package>.<Service>/<Method>` with a JSON (or
binary protobuf) body, and answers with JSON or a Connect error. The
contracts are the `.proto` files in `libs/proto`; gRPC and gRPC-Web
clients can use the same paths, and the server answers gRPC reflection.

Sign in with `AuthService/Login` and send the access token it returns as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Methods marked as needing no
authentication, such as signing in and the health check, take none.

Media bytes are served over plain HTTP: the files of a playback under
`/media/`, where the playback ID is the credential, and images under
`/images/`, where the image or item ID is. Streaming methods, such as
`EventService/Subscribe`, are not listed here.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

google.protobuf.Duration.description: A signed duration in seconds, with up to nine fractional digits and an `s` suffix (for example, `3s` or `-0.001s`).

google.protobuf.FieldMask.description: Comma-separated field paths in lowerCamelCase (for example, `user.displayName,photo`).

google.protobuf.Timestamp.description: A point in time in RFC 3339 format, with up to nanosecond precision. Output uses UTC (`Z`); input may use an offset from UTC.

tags.description: Media bytes over plain HTTP.

tags.name: ReleaseService
tags.description:
ReleaseService searches the indexers of the indexer provider plugins for
 releases, the torrents and NZBs of movies and episodes, and parses their
 titles as Radarr and Sonarr do. Administrators only.

tags.name: ProfileService
tags.description:
ProfileService keeps what decides which releases are grabbed: quality
 definitions, quality profiles, custom formats, delay and release
 profiles; and the remote path mappings of download clients.
 Administrators only, but for listing quality profiles, which users who
 may request media read too.

tags.name: RequestService
tags.description:
RequestService takes users' requests of movies and seasons of series,
 as Seerr's: administrators approve or decline them, unless the user's
 requests are approved at once, and approved requests are acquired.
 Signed-in users request what their policy allows, within their quotas
 and their rating limit, and see their own requests; administrators
 manage all.

tags.name: DiscoverService
tags.description:
DiscoverService lists the movies and series the discovery providers
 offer, such as trending or popular titles, and those they find by name,
 marked with what the server has of them: available, wanted or
 requested; it details a title with the status of each of its seasons.
 Titles rated above the caller's rating limit are left out. Signed-in
 users.

tags.name: DownloadService
tags.description:
DownloadService sends releases to the download clients of the download
 client provider plugins and tracks them until they are imported: the
 queue, the history and the blocklist. Administrators only.

tags.name: IssueService
tags.description:
IssueService takes the problems users report with items, as Seerr's
 issues: users who may report issues report them and comment on their
 own; administrators see, comment on, resolve and delete all.

tags.name: UserService
tags.description:
UserService manages accounts. All methods except GetCurrentUser and
 UpdatePreferences require an administrator.

tags.name: UserDataService
tags.description: UserDataService reads and updates the calling user's per-item state.

tags.name: ItemService
tags.description: ItemService browses and searches library items.

tags.name: WantedService
tags.description:
WantedService adds the movies and series to acquire, and searches for
 them. Administrators only.

tags.name: AuthService
tags.description:
AuthService signs clients in and out. GetAuthInfo, CreateFirstUser and
 Login are public; the other methods act on the calling user.

tags.name: LibraryService
tags.description: LibraryService manages libraries and their scans.

tags.name: HomeService
tags.description:
HomeService lists the hubs of Home and of the libraries' Recommended
 tabs: rows of items, each a reason to watch something, chosen per
 library by administrators. Home starts with continue watching across
 the libraries and the requests that became available, follows with the
 Home hubs of each library the user pinned, in their order, and ends with
 trending titles. Hubs the user hid and hubs without items are left out.
 The user's choices are display preferences of client "mavio", view
 "home": "libraries" lists the pinned library IDs in order, comma
 separated, all libraries in name order when unset; "hidden" lists the
 IDs of hidden hubs, which cannot hide continue watching. Items are those
 the caller may access. Signed-in users.

tags.name: CollectionService
tags.description:
CollectionService lets administrators curate collections: named sets of
 items across libraries, such as a film series. Collections are items of
 the collections library; users with access to it list them with
 ItemService.ListItems and their members with its parent_id, seeing the
 members their policy allows.

tags.name: MetadataService
tags.description:
MetadataService corrects and completes the metadata of items:
 administrators edit and lock it, identify items again against the
 metadata providers, refresh them, choose their images and download
 subtitles. In libraries saving local metadata, changes are also written
 next to the media as NFO files and image files.

tags.name: PlaylistService
tags.description:
PlaylistService manages the caller's playlists: ordered lists of media
 items in which an item may appear several times, each entry with its own
 ID. Playlists are items of the playlists library that only their owner
 sees; ItemService.GetItem returns them and ListItems with their ID as
 parent_id lists their items once each.

tags.name: PlaybackService
tags.description:
PlaybackService decides how a client plays an item and tracks the
 playback. All methods act for the calling user.

tags.name: SyncPlayService
tags.description:
SyncPlayService lets online devices watch together: the members of a
 group play the same queue at the same position, as in Jellyfin's
 SyncPlay. Each change reaches the members as a SyncPlayUpdate event with
 the group and, when they have to act, a command timed in server time;
